Flags: U1–U12 (USP_* env vars), APP_LIVE, SHOW_PRICES. Tokens: {phone}, {hours}, {legalName}, {foundedYear}, {founderName}, {founderRole} are filled from data/site.json. parts.text: We plan to launch in January 2027. Until then you can join early access: we are inviting pilot homes in Patna, and everyone on the list gets a special early-access offer, confirmed in a written quote before you pay anything.

items.q: Do I need to change my switches?

parts.text: No. Homeasy modules fit inside your existing switchbox, behind the switches you already have.

items.q: How do you convert a normal switch to a smart switch?

parts.text: We fit a Homeasy module inside the switchbox, behind your normal switch. The switch looks and works the same, and you can also control it from the app. In most homes this gives you a smart home without rewiring.
No rewiring in most homes. Our free survey checks your wiring first. If something needs a small fix, we'll tell you before you pay.
Yes. Your switches work by hand exactly as before, even if the internet is down.
No. From the outside, it looks the same. If a switchbox needs a visible change, we agree it with you in the quote first.

items.q: What is a neutral wire and do I need one?

parts.text: It's one of the wires in your switchbox. Some modules need it, and our survey checks every box. A no-neutral option is planned.
Installations are done by trained electricians following a safety checklist. If we find a wiring problem, we tell you first.
It depends on the number of rooms and switchboxes. We'll confirm timing at your survey.
Yes, within our service area.
We survey homes across Bihar. Our head office and pilot are in Patna.
3 years on Homeasy modules against manufacturing defects.

items.q: How fast do you fix problems?

parts.text: We reply on WhatsApp within 30 minutes during working hours ({hours}).
We reply on WhatsApp during working hours, {hours}.
In Patna, a technician visits within 24 hours.
If a visit is needed, we arrange a technician as soon as we can. A visit-time promise for Patna launches after our pilot.

items.q: Who do I contact for support?

parts.text: WhatsApp or call our support team on {phone}.

items.q: Can I add more rooms later?

parts.text: Yes, anytime.

items.q: Can I install it in a rented home?

parts.text: Usually yes, as nothing visible changes. Check with your landlord first.
Yes, free for every Homeasy customer.
Yes. The Homeasy app will be free for every Homeasy customer. It is coming soon.
Both.
Both. The Android and iOS apps are coming soon.

items.q: What if the internet goes down?

parts.text: Your switches always work by hand. App control needs Wi-Fi and internet.

items.q: Does it work with Alexa or Google Home?

parts.text: Not yet. Voice assistant support is planned. We'll announce it only when it is ready.
Yes, with family sharing in the app.
It depends on your rooms and appliances. Your exact price is confirmed after the free survey.
Yes. One price covers modules, installation, app setup and GST.
Your written quote shows the full amount, including taxes, before you decide.
We share payment options with your quote. The survey is free.

items.q: Do you work with interior designers, builders or government?

parts.text: Yes. We work with interior designers, builders, electricians and government buildings.
{legalName}, founded in {foundedYear} in Patna, led by {founderRole} {founderName}.
